title: StockSmart Inventory Finance Schedule — Annual Usage Value Share in the Fill-To Level of a Consigned Bin Taking Over a VendPoint Item
content:
### Value class of a transferred item

The fill-to level of a new consigned bin under the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program that takes over an item the customer has had taken out of one of its VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machines is set lower when the item is of high annual value: the item's value class puts a value-class share into the carried share of that bin's fill-to level.

**Annual usage value.** The transferred item's annual usage value is its net vends of the last twelve months times its vend price, the highest unit price among its vends at the demand machine dated on its most recent vend date there, and zero where it has no vend there. Net vends are units vended at the machine the item was removed from at the customer's request, less units returned to that machine and units credited there as vend errors. The last twelve months hold rows of age below twelve, a row's age in whole months being the number of calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the row's day of the month.

**Schedule.**

| Annual usage value, USD | Value-class share put into the carried share of the bin's fill-to level |
|---|---|
| 5000.00 or more | 0.75 |
| 1000.00 or more but below 5000.00 | 0.9 |
| below 1000.00 | none; the carried share is left as it is |

### Hypothetical cases

- 400 net units over twelve months, with the most recent vend date carrying two vends at 12.00 and 12.50: the vend price is 12.50 and the annual usage value 5000.00, exactly on the upper line, so 0.75 applies.
- 100 net units at a vend price of 9.99: 999.00, below 1000.00, so no value-class share is put in.
- An item with no vend at the machine: annual usage value zero.
